template.description: Charlie Buster has established himself as one of the foremost artists of this age and in multiple art forms. His unique style takes a lighthearted approach, rather than the typical grim slant of street art, differentiating him from his contemporaries and giving his art a relatable quality. Using varied materials (including acrylics, paint pens, stencils, spray paint, and vintage photos) Charlie subversively depicts various current icons of pop culture using he’s own unique approach to create he’s extremely colourful illustrations, in the process has generated his own recognisable style of street art.
